key_path: No developer API key (public API shut down). Personal agent path: add remote MCP https://mcp-server.zomato.com/mcp in Claude (custom connector or official directory listing), ChatGPT, VS Code or Postman.
Client registers via DCR (/register) -> OAuth authorize -> log in to Zomato (phone OTP) -> token.
Tools: restaurant discovery, menus, cart, place order, QR-code payment (user pays via UPI QR).
Custom clients (e.g. Claude Code localhost redirect) are NOT on the redirect-URI allowlist -> must fill 'MCP Developer Access' form (personal use only) and wait for review.

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - RFC 7591 registration_endpoint https://mcp-server.zomato.com/register, PKCE S256, token auth 'none'; but redirect URIs allowlisted to claude.ai, chatgpt.com, vscode.dev, Postman

local: via `npx mcp-remote https://mcp-server.zomato.com/mcp` for Claude Desktop free plan
types: consumer commerce MCP with real ordering + payment
mcp.directories: Claude directory: 'Zomato'. Works as ChatGPT custom connector (chatgpt.com redirect allowlisted).
agentic_commerce_protocols: proprietary MCP order + UPI QR payment; llms.txt documents cookie-session web APIs for in-browser agents

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: yes - zomato.com/llms.txt: a full agent playbook for in-browser agents (listing/menu/cart endpoints, cookie+CSRF auth, 'obtain explicit user confirmation before placing orders'). /mcp-tools.md referenced but 403.
docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: Paradox: ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended -> Allow /llms.txt and /mcp-tools.md, Disallow / everything else

score_justification: Only company in the batch letting a consumer agent actually place and pay for an order, with standards-compliant DCR, but restricted to allowlisted clients and personal use, labeled 'testing purposes', and robots blocks AI agents from the site.
best_practice: llms.txt written as an operating manual for browser agents with explicit confirm-before-order rule; DCR-enabled remote MCP with one-click VS Code install.
biggest_gap: No third-party apps permitted; redirect allowlist breaks DCR for new clients; robots.txt contradicts the llms.txt invitation.
